thread:
maria: heads up — getting a spike of 502/504s from hosted API for a small set of customers, started ~10m ago. full request rate steady but error rate up on edge. :warning:
kevin: seeing it too, alerted by customer-123 ticket. do we have any correlating deploys?
sre-elena: not a deploy on runtime, but infra metrics show increased upstream resets from envoy on frontdoor. attaching a couple trace ids: trace: 01-abc123-aaa, 01-def456-bbb.
maria: logs (edge envoy):
```
[2026-03-16T15:12:03Z] envoy upstream reset: connection failure, downstream_remote_close
[2026-03-16T15:12:04Z] route missing for request with header-length=24512, trimmed=true
```
kevin: header-length 24k — that's large. any recent middleware adding headers?
billing-carter: we rolled a billing-sync job ~15m before spike to add tenant-usage header for analytics. it can add ~10-20kb metadata for large tenants. i can pause it.
support-josh: customer flow is long streaming request (chat streaming) + our billing header, maybe combined it exceeds upstream limits and envoy/ingress drops it -> 502s. customer reported intermittent 502 on streaming and full response loss. workaround for them: use smaller tenant payload or opt-out of detailed usage header.
sre-elena: can you repro locally with curl? try to emulate streaming preface + large header.
maria: repro steps i used:
```bash
curl -v -H "X-Tenant-Meta: $(python -c 'print("A"*22000)')" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  --data-binary @payload.ndjson \
  "https://api.redwood-hosted.example/v1/stream?model=chat-small"
```
result: immediate 502 with upstream reset. without X-Tenant-Meta it succeeds.
kevin: any nginx/ingress config that trims headers? i know some LB tiers drop or truncate long headers which can cause routing mismatch.
sre-elena: yes, frontdoor uses envoy with header size limits and we also have a downstream nginx layer that collapses oversized header sets. two failure modes: 1) header truncation causing missing tenant header -> routing to default tenant -> upstream 404/502, 2) upstream rejects too-large header -> connection reset. logs show both behaviors.
billing-carter: pausing billing-sync now — rolled a kill (job id: billing-sync-20260316-3). :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollback request submitted for billing-sync feature-flag (PR #4123) — link: https://git.redwood/ops/4123
maria: after pausing, error rate dropped ~80% in 4m. rolling customer patch not needed yet but still open.
support-josh: Customer-123 updated: they saw 502s during the spike but back to normal now, asked what caused it and if it will happen again.
sre-elena: short term mitigation: (1) pause billing-sync (done), (2) add server-side header-sanitizer at edge to trim non-critical headers >8k, (3) increase envoy header limit on a small canary pool while we test.
kevin: can we add a quick logging rule to capture full header sizes for future repro?
sre-elena: yes adding a logging metric: edge.header_bytes and edge.trim_events. will push in next 10m.
billing-carter: long-term we'll switch to a separate analytics stream instead of injecting large tenant blobs into the request path. tracked in ENG-987.
maria: summary for ticket: root cause = billing-sync started injecting large X-Tenant-Meta headers causing header truncation and upstream resets at the edge (envoy/nginx), resulting in 502/504s for streaming routes. mitigation = paused job, added temporary sanitizer and logging, follow-up rollback PR in CI.
support-josh: forwarding summary to customer-123 + advising optional opt-out. :mailbox_with_mail:
sre-elena: monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/edge-errors?from=now-1h to watch. will keep thread updated. :eyes:
maria: thanks team, marking for postmortem if customers affected >5. :+1:
